fixtures.source: data/swimcloud-captures (git-ignored, local only): team-412-2026-2027, team-58-2026-2027, team-48-2026-2027, captured 2026-10-04
fixtures.kept: Both roster pages per team whole (scripts, header, nav and footer removed: they held the account name and a form secret). 12 of each team's real times responses (6 men, 6 women), byte for byte. The rule and the original hashes are in tests/fixtures/theoretical-meet/manifest.json.

facts.engineNeeds: Baseline reads sourceMenResults/sourceWomenResults (else menResults/womenResults). Individual scoring groups by event, roundSwam and rank; equal rank is one tie. A prelims round scores only distance events and diving. The NSISC scorer roster adds an athlete only from an A Final or B Final row. pdfPoints must be absent so the settings table applies. Result ids are primary keys across workspaces.
facts.bands: Places 1 to the A bracket are A Final, the next bracket B Final, the rest Preliminaries. rank is the overall place. Bracket is aFinalBracketSize, else half the table.
facts.ties: Standard competition ranking (1, 2, 2, 4), the rule behind prepareRecruitsForScoring. A test pins the two.
facts.eventOrderMatters: With no Event N labels the engine scores events in row order. NSISC has an 18-scorer meet-wide pool filled in that order, so event order can change who scores. Rows use the standard program order. No event numbers are invented. A caveat says so.
facts.provenance: SwimmerResult has no source field and the workspace table has no column for one. Provenance is returned beside the payload (sources, keyed by result id) and is not persisted.
facts.loadedMeet: pdfFilename and meetLabel both carry THEORETICAL_MEET_LABEL. The sidebar, RosterSourceStep and the Matrix meet step read pdfFilename only; swimCloudMeetImportBridge sets it the same way for a meet with no PDF.
facts.noPageBytesRoute: No capture route returns page bytes. The roster season id needs the roster page's season table, so theoreticalMeetFromCaptures takes an optional readRosterPageHtml dependency. Without it rosterSeasonId stays undefined and the seed builder's caveat stands.

reviewFixes.source: architect review of b9658efa (scratch probes reproduced T1, T2, T6)
reviewFixes.T1: FIXED. Places past twice the A bracket are C Final, not Preliminaries. A prelims row made hasPrelimsData true and the prelims-vs-finals view showed every team at 0 with an over/under equal to its whole total (472 of 696 men rows on the real data). Tests: hasPrelimsData false and prelims projection empty on constructed rows, on the fixtures and on the real captures; totals unchanged (real: Henderson men 931).
reviewFixes.T2: FIXED in both builders. usePdfPlacePoints === true throws invalid-scoring-settings, naming settingsForBuiltInScoringPreset(presetIdForConference(conference)). Tested with the exact shape buildScoringPatchForParsedPdf saves. auto and false stay allowed.
reviewFixes.T3: FIXED. eventOrder?: readonly string[] on buildTheoreticalMeetWorkspace, theoreticalEventOrderFromMeetResults(rows) reads a real meet order from its Event N labels, eventOrderSource and warnings on the result, caveat states the size (several percent, measured up to 7%). Applied to row order, which is the engine mechanism for rows with no Event N label; no event number is written. Real data, Henderson men: program order 931, real 2026 NSISC order 997 (+66), reversed program order 897 (-34), as the architect measured. The 12-swimmer fixtures do not fill the pool, so no fixture total moves; hand-derived pool tests (202 vs 250) prove the direction.
reviewFixes.T4: FIXED. The parse route returns storedPages (canonicalUrl, resourceKind, entryRetrievedAt, contentSha256) additively. theoreticalMeetFromCaptures compares with the record sha256: page-bytes-drifted warning per page, driftedPages and unverifiedPages in the capture summary, and a drifted page takes the stored bytes write time as its retrievedAt (team, athlete, swims, seed source). A parse with no stamps counts every used page as unverified. Fixture records already matched the trimmed bytes (the generator rewrote them); a test now asserts it for every page.
reviewFixes.T5: FIXED. Parse warnings are counted by code (summarizeParseWarnings) into the capture summary (parseWarnings) and a line on every team. Real data: only diving-score-not-a-time (28, 7, 21 on the full captures; 6, 4, 12 on the fixtures).
reviewFixes.T6: FIXED. captureStore has a second KeyedAsyncMutex keyed by canonicalUrl around archive-and-write and around the page delete. Order is captureId lock then URL lock, always. Test: two captures write one URL with Promise.all, 50 rounds, all three versions survive (cache plus pages-superseded). The race reproduced on round 0 before the fix.
reviewFixes.T7: FIXED. swimCloudPageBytesDiffer ignores csrfmiddlewaretoken values (either attribute order); a token-only change archives nothing. The new bytes are still written.
reviewFixes.T8: FIXED (season) and ANSWERED (exhibition). rosterSeasonId needs proof: URL season_id, or a printed season; with neither the table selected option counts only when it equals the subject label, else a warning. Exhibition and eventgender: see report; no core edit.
reviewFixes.newWorkspaceGap: POST /api/workspaces with an existing id overwrites that workspace and deletes its rows (WorkspaceService.create). Server not changed. buildTheoreticalMeetWorkspace documents that workspaceId must be fresh, and newTheoreticalWorkspaceId() (crypto.randomUUID) is exported and tested.
